changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE reviews ( location_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), rating DOUBLE PRECISION CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5), comment TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY (location_id, user_id) );
